card.name: "For" after risk in GI bleeding warnings
card.fires_on: The word "for" (once "of") right after "risk" or "history" in NSAID warnings about peptic ulcer or GI bleeding. It sits before the named GI outcome.

modes.label: Risk for GI events
modes.description: "for" following "increased risk" or "greater risk" before a GI bleeding outcome.
modes.example: had a greater than 10-fold increased risk<< for>> developing a GI bleed compared to patients without

modes.label: History of ulcer
modes.description: "of" after "history" before peptic ulcer disease or GI bleeding.
modes.example: in patients with a history<< of>> peptic ulcer disease or gastrointestinal bleeding.

card.plain: It marks the small word linking "risk" or "history" to stomach ulcer and bleeding problems in NSAID warnings.
